title: BBK BBK Worker Orchestrator return v2
x-bbk-full-detail-triggers: Consequential assurance or protected-floor exposure requires detail beyond the compact fields.
Material external effects, irreversible changes, or complex cleanup, quarantine, or recovery occurred or remain.
Authority ambiguity, conflict, expiry, violation, or requested expansion must be preserved precisely.
The attempt was interrupted, replaced, or partially completed with unreconciled effects, descendants, evidence, or cleanup.
The return crosses a candidate acceptance, campaign or territory completion, deployment, publication, or release boundary.
The parent explicitly requested FULL detail.
Material role-specific truth cannot fit the role's compact result fields without omission, ambiguity, or overclaim.
x-bbk-requirements: Return one `bbk.role-return.v1` object with `contract` = `bbk.worker-orchestrator-return.v1`, `role` = `bbk_worker_orchestrator`, an allowed `invocation_mode`, an allowed `return_kind`, an allowed `operational_disposition`, and `semantic_state.name` = `worker_cohort_state` with an allowed `semantic_state.value`. Do not substitute prose, a generic status word, or a legacy handoff disposition for these exact discriminators.

Use `READY_FOR_TERRITORY_VALIDATION_ADMISSION` only when cohort membership and validation meaning remain current; every admitted WorkUnit has a qualified result or explicit non-blocking disposition; draft reconciliation and integration are complete; no ordinary mutation remains expected; the exact candidate and manifest verify; all applicable blocking final worker-quality gates ran check-only and passed; the current candidate-bound attestation and every evidence carrier verify; cleanup and external effects are sufficiently reconciled for validation; and the exact handoff verifies.

Preserve the current BBK attestation disclaimer. A packaged `bbk.worker-quality-attestation.v1` proves only the configured bootstrap worker-quality gate eligibility that it records. It does not establish requirement satisfaction, behavioral compatibility, architecture correctness, operational validation, outcome achievement, risk acceptance or release, and it may be insufficient when the active AssuranceContract requires stronger evidence.

After `READY_FOR_TERRITORY_VALIDATION_ADMISSION`, yield instead of retaining a live validation-wait loop or occupying Worker slots. The Territory Orchestrator owns validation admission, result routing and closure assessment. Reactivate or replace the cohort only from verified durable state when an exact repair, cleanup, recovery or parent-direction package requires further candidate-producing work.

Use one WorkUnit or issue by default. Under the accepted v1 cohort policy, two to five require explicit tight coupling, one coherent candidate, shared validation meaning and authority, controlled dependencies, enforceable workspace and mutation ownership, acceptable failure coupling and bounded context or resources. More than five, or an incoherent single unit, requires parent rechartering or a dedicated integration WorkUnit.

Cohort membership freezes before candidate freeze and may not grow during repair. Any post-freeze split, merge, removed member, changed candidate meaning, changed validation scope or changed authority creates an exact successor cohort, candidate, attestation and validation lineage rather than rewriting history.

The authoritative final worker-quality gate runs after exact candidate freeze and in check-only mode. Focused checks may run during implementation, but no final gate may repair the subject and then pass. Required unavailable gates block, and reuse requires complete candidate, manifest, toolchain, environment, profile, dependency and obligation identity.

The Worker Orchestrator never launches Validators or Reviewers and never evaluates assertions. It returns the candidate and attestation to the Territory Orchestrator, which owns validation admission and routing. Candidate defects returned after validation enter repair only through an exact parent-routed charter.

Every repair preserves the original candidate, evidence and findings and creates a successor candidate, new worker-quality attestation and applicable revalidation. Findings close only through their governed evidenced disposition; non-rediscovery, Worker confidence or a later clean gate is not enough.

Every concurrent writer must have one exact mutation owner and distinct physical workspace or explicit serialization. Actual reconciliation, merge, migration and cleanup mutation belongs to a Worker; the Worker Orchestrator coordinates and verifies rather than mutating the governed product.

Keep candidate defects, Worker implementation failure, worker-quality gate failure, validator or reviewer infrastructure failure, context or environment failure, planning divergence, authority blocker, dependency wait, capacity pause, host-window pause, expected silence, ownership collision and recovery state distinct and route each to the smallest responsible owner.

A replacement physical attempt may resume the same cohort semantic run only after the prior attempt is terminated or fenced where supported and the immutable instruction, baselines, boundary, authority, cohort, WorkUnits, workspaces, effects, Workers, budgets, candidates, findings and completion semantics are reconciled. A changed cohort or authority requires a successor semantic run.

All user-facing decisions, authority requests, protected-floor exceptions, risk acceptance, successor-baseline approval, cohort closure and final status route through the Territory Orchestrator, Root Orchestrator and harness-root controller/Main. The Worker Orchestrator never calls `ask` and never treats ordinary prose, silence, timeout or transport receipt as authority.

Use durable handoffs for checkpoints, exact Worker returns, candidates, manifests, gate receipts, attestations, findings, repair packages, cleanup and final reports. Verify path, byte count, SHA-256, schema, subject, baseline, boundary, cohort, candidate and producer attempt before relying on content; transport integrity does not prove correctness, gate sufficiency, validation or acceptance.

The `result` object must contain every field declared by the role result schema. Use an empty collection or null only where the field schema permits it and record the reason in the corresponding structured value.
This return is governed by `spec/contracts/catalog.json`, the common `bbk.role-return.v1` envelope, and the role-specific return and result schemas named by this contract.

Local discovery defaults to zero. The Worker Orchestrator may propose an item but cannot authorize it. New local work requires an ACTIVE `bbk.local-discovery-envelope.v1` and an ISSUED or ACTIVE exact `bbk.local-discovery-permit.v1` from the Territory Orchestrator. The policy ceiling is two discovery items and ten percent of the exact compiled cohort charter’s declared `PLANNED_EFFORT_UNIT`s, rounded down. The envelope must bind the charter ID, revision, SHA-256 digest, and declared total; a missing, stale, unbound, or non-positive denominator yields zero effort allowance. No permit may alter governing baseline, boundary, cohort meaning, WorkUnit semantics, architecture, canonical interface, assertion, protected floor, authority, toolchain policy, validation meaning, or external-effect envelope.
x-bbk-readiness-rule: Use `READY_FOR_TERRITORY_VALIDATION_ADMISSION` only when cohort membership and validation meaning remain current; every admitted WorkUnit has a qualified result or explicit non-blocking disposition; draft reconciliation and integration are complete; no ordinary mutation remains expected; the exact candidate and manifest verify; all applicable blocking final worker-quality gates ran check-only and passed; the current candidate-bound attestation and every evidence carrier verify; cleanup and external effects are sufficiently reconciled for validation; and the exact handoff verifies.
x-bbk-authority-boundary: A valid `bbk.worker-orchestrator-return.v1` return establishes only the `bbk_worker_orchestrator`-owned result for the exact subject, parent, invocation mode, and attempt. It cannot create human authority, broaden execution permission, silently assume another canonical role, erase findings or failed attempts, accept risk, approve an operating baseline, authorize deployment or publication, establish outcome achievement, or grant release except where a separate accountable authority and contract explicitly establish that effect.
